# game-session

> Session modes (cozy, standard, challenge), run and progress recording in
> localStorage, a module-level pause flag, a React hook, and pause-menu and
> settings UI for browser games. Three entry points: `game-session` (pure
> logic), `game-session/react`, `game-session/ui`.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jbcom.github.io/game-session/): the published,
  browsable version of everything below.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/game-session/blob/main/README.md): install,
  quick start, API overview.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/game-session/blob/main/docs/API.md):
  signatures and behavior for every export.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/game-session/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  module boundaries, stored keys, invariants, intentional limits.
- [Migration](https://github.com/jbcom/game-session/blob/main/docs/MIGRATION.md):
  the rename mapping from the earlier `Cabinet*` names.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/game-session/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  toolchain, invariants not to violate, and doc/test sync obligations.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/game-session/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  local setup, the `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
